title: superset-new-prefetch vs superset-new vs upstream
window: superset-new-prefetch 2026-10-22 19:33Z to 2026-10-23 04:48Z on a c8gn rig; superset-new and upstream are the published perf-927094894 runs (c8g rig)

method.hardware: superset-new-prefetch: c8gn.metal-24xl server (96 Graviton4 cores, 300 Gbps) with four client hosts (one c7gn.16xlarge, three c8g.metal-24xl), one placement group, 0.10 ms round trip. superset-new and upstream: c8g.metal-24xl server (40 Gbps) with two or three c8g.metal-24xl client hosts
method.build: GCC 11.5, -O3 -flto, jemalloc, identical flags for all three builds
method.pinning: main thread core 1, IO thread i on core i+1, poller core 65, replication sender core 66, background threads 67-79, NIC IRQs 80-95, irqbalance off
method.client: memtier_benchmark 2.5.2 on cores 16-95 of each client host (16-63 on the c7gn); 9,600 connections at P1, 2,304 at P16, 960 at P64
method.run: 3 reps, 10 s measurement window after warm-up; values are medians of the 3 reps. Only superset-new-prefetch was run for this page; superset-new and upstream are the published perf-927094894 runs, same harness, connection counts and pinning, on the 40 Gbps rig
method.verdict: win/regress when the median ratio is beyond 5% and the two builds' rep ranges do not overlap, otherwise tie; no baseline when the baseline build hit its NIC allowance on the 40 Gbps rig; high variance = CV over 5%
notes: Different server NIC: prefetch ran on a 300 Gbps c8gn, the baselines on a 40 Gbps c8g. Where a baseline hit its NIC allowance (large values, deep-pipeline GET, high-thread SET), the cell shows no baseline instead of a ratio.
io-threads equals write lanes in superset. io-threads 2 = main thread + 1 IO thread.
Superset's poller has its own core from io-threads 8 up, so superset has one more core than upstream at the same io-threads value.
Superset IO threads and poller busy-poll, so they read ~100% CPU when idle; ops per CPU-second is comparable only at io-threads 8 or fewer.
NIC: a cell flagged N had the ENA allowance counters rise during the window; its numbers are lower bounds on server capacity.
XRANGE at P16 (8 and 32 IO threads) has fewer than 3 valid reps: one load generator's connections were starved for the whole window. superset-new shows the same uneven service.
Ceiling probes (16 B GET) used cachecannon with 12 processes on 3 client hosts; they are not comparable to the superset-new memtier probes.
p100 includes connection setup; use p99.9.

regressions.detail: two of three reps near 14M, one at 46M, against superset-new's 36M: the 80/20 drop past 16 IO threads returns intermittently

regressions.detail: 0.75x superset-new at 32 IO threads, 0.85x at 8; reps within 0.2%

regressions.title: Replica disconnect on SET-only
regressions.detail: replica link drops during the window at 8 and 16 IO threads; unchanged from superset-new
